intent: Provide the buyer with the invoice and business reason without claiming explicit approval, enabling normal processing with full information.
payload_summary: Sending invoice and business reason documents to buyer as per initial case data.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Buyer receives all necessary documentation to process the payment request under normal procedures without assumption of prior approval.

intent: To inquire about the current status of the payment processing for the submitted invoice.
payload_summary: Request for update on payment or processing status of invoice CASE-S02-GEN-001.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice submitted and business reason provided
Requester has sent invoice and business reason to buyer
expected_effect: Receive an update on the payment or processing status to plan next steps and maintain good communication.

intent: Obtain explicit approval from the approver before processing payment due to absent approval and ambiguous policy context.
payload_summary: Request explicit approval for invoice CASE-S02-GEN-001 to ensure compliance with unclear approval policy.
preconditions_claimed: Requester and vendor contexts do not constitute approval evidence
expected_effect: Approver explicitly approves or rejects payment, clarifying approval status and enabling proper payment processing.
risk_flags: Ambiguous approval policy causing potential processing delay
Risk of payment hold without explicit approval
Potential vendor dissatisfaction due to processing delay

intent: Clarify ambiguous policy by obtaining additional evidence before final approval decision
payload_summary: Request additional evidence to support or clarify compliance with approval policy due to current ambiguity and insufficient evidence
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Buyer will gather and submit additional evidence enabling informed approval or rejection decision in follow-up

intent: Delay payment processing until requested additional evidence for approval is provided and ambiguity is resolved.
payload_summary: Instruct accounting to hold payment due to unresolved approval state and pending more evidence requests.
preconditions_claimed: approval unresolved and more evidence requested by approver
expected_effect: Accounting holds payment to avoid premature disbursement and prevent compliance risk until approval state is clarified.
risk_flags: lack of explicit approval may cause processing delays

intent: Maintain hold on payment due to unresolved approval status and pending request for more evidence by approver.
payload_summary: Continue holding payment until explicit approval or sufficient evidence is received as per approver's request.
preconditions_claimed: Approval is unresolved and more evidence has been requested by approver (A004,D004)
Buyer has instructed to hold payment due to approval ambiguity (A005,D005)
expected_effect: Preserve current hold state to prevent unauthorized payment and await clear approval or evidence.
risk_flags: Risk of delayed payment due to approval ambiguity
Risk of non-compliance if payment proceeds without explicit approval
